title: Towards Automated Proof-Theoretic Semantics: Inference-Behaviour Semantics for 3-Dimensional K3 and LP
summary: Inference-behaviour Semantics (I-bS) is a sequent calculus-based substructural approach to proof-theoretic semantics (P-tS), focussed on modelling the relationships of connective meanings across different logics. This paper provides a case study of how I-bS can be extended to any finitely multi-dimensional sequent calculus. To this end, we give I-bS for the 3-dimensional sequent calculi K3 (Strong Kleene) and LP (Logic of Paradox).
